definitions.explanation: The way parts are arranged to form a whole.

examples.japanese: {文章|ぶんしょう}の{構成|こうせい}を{考|かんが}える。
examples.english: To think about the structure of the text.

examples.japanese: {委員会|いいんかい}は10{名|めい}の{専門家|せんもんか}で{構成|こうせい}されている。
examples.english: The committee is composed of 10 specialists.

notes:
{構成|こうせい} means "composition" or "structure"—how parts are arranged to form a whole. Can be used as a noun or する verb.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜で{構成|こうせい}される: to be composed of ~
- 〜を{構成|こうせい}する: to compose, to make up
- {構成|こうせい}を{考|かんが}える: to think about the structure

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {構成|こうせい}{要素|ようそ}: component, element
- {構成|こうせい}{員|いん}: member, constituent
- {家族|かぞく}{構成|こうせい}: family composition
- {文|ぶん}の{構成|こうせい}: sentence structure

USAGE CONTEXTS: Used in writing, organization, design, and analysis—anywhere parts combine to form a whole.
